notes.title: FSOG 3 Valentine's Update is here!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

Happy Valentine's Day to you all! Let the loved ones of yours know how much you love them tonight. And we've prepared decent discounts for you to help in this case! [b]Grab Furry Shades Of Gay 3 with a nice [b]discount of 30%[/b] now and pick up other games in the series with a discount of 50%![/b]

Now, let's celebrate together with a new story, shall we?

[h2]Evan and Master are back![/h2] 

This Valentine’s Day is special for Evan. Him and his Master have been together for quite a while, and he’s excited to spend this special day together. He's a little nervous though? What are they to each other? Friends with benefits or something more? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/86db977214ff80abd5d094b18018b51fd29c23df.png[/img]

You can tell he's not the only one having a crisis there - his Master is clearly trying to tell Evan something important. Will they get distracted during their happy little dinner with all the gear in Master's house, or will their choice be a little more romantic this time? 

Find out in the story! There are more secrets to this couple than you think. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/d7f2fdb6f4f4bf06016e693127a9802a88d3c704.png[/img]

Wishlist our new game, if you're into girls as well:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221840/Sex_and_the_Furry_Titty_3_Come_Inside_Sweety/

And if you're into solving mysteries, boys, girls and other funky sexy creatures, we invite you into our Mansion of Memories:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575040/Mansion_of_Memories/

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url]

XO, 
Shane

notes.title: FURRY SHADES OF GAY 3 - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello there, friends! 

[h2][b]IT'S HERE![/b][/h2]

Go grab yourself a copy of  Furry Shades Of Gay 3, because it's out [b]NOW[/b]! I'm so glad I don't have to keep these stories all to myself anymore! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/c0e0316e1ff843916024e5aec9053d97dbfdffd7.png[/img]

[h2]5 NEW STORIES![/h2]

It's finally time to welcome our new boys in the family, as well as say hi to your deeply loved couple! Find lots of new ways to entertain a smoking hot boy at work and pick the boss' attention, visit Italian winery with a chance of getting something more than just photos, take care of the back pain (hot masseur included!), choose a love nest with your all-time favorites and spend the last summer day and night in the scout camp. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/1ecda79dfc0a41c1c60efb68fac77acf19113ccd.png[/img]

[h2]THE LOVE POTION OF STORIES AND PUZZLES![/h2]
 
Third time is the charm - hotter, bigger, louder! The stories are now partially voiced, they have become longer and funnier to explore. And the cherry on top - drop dead hot animations of all the hot boys making love! What more to wish for? There's nothing like a good old challenge of Match-3 - we took all the best from the previous games and made it better for you! Solve the puzzles and have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/18b6c7abf4741dd9cdeec33f786eb2b24d42d22b.png[/img]

[h2]SO WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?[/h2]

No matter if you're an old fan or just got here - we've got everything you need to start and continue your journey into the sweet paradise of love, lust and hottest boys in the area! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/ecb923c4819fbd79db5f0bbd1c99c3dc309fcefd.png[/img]

We're so happy to finally bring you our new game, it's such a pleasure to see you all gather for our releases, we appreciate your support and endless love. Each of us worked hard for this one, and I'm sure you'll like Furry Shades Of Gay 3 as much, as previous parts. 

Okay, it's time to go and play, enjoy the game and don't forget, that we're always open for the feedback! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953540/Furry_Shades_of_Gay_3_Still_Gayer/

Can't wait to see what you think of the new boys and new stories. 

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url]

XO, 
Shane

notes.title: FURRY SHADES OF GAY 2 - NOW WITH SOUND!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends!

Happy Pride everyone! We stand with you every single day of our work. We're proud of you and who you are. Love must be worshipped no matter what. We've launched a sale to celebrate - [b]Furry Shades Of Gay 2 is now 50% off![/b]

With this in mind, we've prepared a very special update - it's special to us, special to you, special to everyone who's participated! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/1d8a409346fef75cb6646d847e0170566af4f0e7.png[/img]

[h1]THE GRAND UPDATE IS OUT![/h1]
All the stories are now voiced and up and running with this freshly uploaded update. Re-discover your old friends with more personality as you go through neatly and carefully voiced stories! The boys are waiting for you. 

We're terribly sorry we couldn't finish all the work on time. There are three characters still waiting for their sound work to be done, but we promise to update the game with their voices in the next few days! 


[h2]VOICED ANIMATIONS![/h2]
Of course, we went through each and every sex scene and made sure you wouldn't go out any of the story lines unsatisfied! The boys are ready to moan and whimper for you. Please, keep your hands hydrated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/e97f4e63b5bceb6c35e80503069db82eab6134c1.png[/img]

[h2]SUPPORTER PACKS ARE UPDATED![/h2]

All the 4k animations with a built-it voice work are now available for purchase, so you can return to them whenever you want and take them with you anywhere you want! Our boys are always ready to serve you with this huge update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/4d285ac4819a0057bde957ebe37a9afe3802ebb3.png[/img]

[h2]SOUNDTRACK IS NOW OBTAINABLE![/h2]
We've worked hard all this time, and with your endless love and support we can now make the game soundtrack obtainable! All your favorite music in one bundle, isn't it cool? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/4665148c9c3b68f3a605ab133723518e2893ebae.png[/img]

Friendly reminder that [b]Furry Shades Of Gay 3 is coming out this September[/b], so go ahead and wishlist it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953540/Furry_Shades_of_Gay_3_Still_Gayer/

Don't forget to share your emotions with us over on social media! Check out our Discord and Twitter for more sexy updates!

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url]


XO
Shane

notes.title: PUZZLE FEST AND DISCOUNTS!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

Long time no see. But here we are with some big news for you! 

[h2]PUZZLE FEST![/h2]
That's right! We're taking part in the Puzzle Fest starting today,  April, 24th - don't miss out on the opportunity to fiddle with our match-3 games full of joy and love! To celebrate this festival we've set up a discount of 50% off! 

On to the next topic! 

[h2]THE GRAND UPDATE IS COMING![/h2]
This summer all our players will get a surprise. 
Now that I've said that in the subtitle, it's no longer a surprise. But hear me out: Furry Shades Of Gay 2 will get the sound work update! That's right, we've been working on giving our boys the most beautiful voices! You'll get to hear them talk a little! And yes, this means you'll hear them moan and whimper in the animated scenes, too!

[h2]CHANGING THE COST[/h2]
Time goes by, we evolve and we need our price tag to evolve, too. 

After Puzzle Fest discounts are gone, Furry Shades Of Gay 2 will raise in price a little so that we can continue making new games and update older ones for you for free! 

So, if you have ever considered picking up a copy of any of our games, now is the [b]perfect[/b] time to do so.

Thanks for staying with us on our journey! Don't forget to check out our social media for more fun stuff!

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url]


XO
Shane

notes.content:
[h3]Hi there, friends![/h3]

Good to see you again. I've been out and about gathering all the news for you, let's check what we have on the discount first. Right now [b]Furry Shades Of Gay 2[/b] is on sale with a nice [b]35% discount[/b], so if you've been hesitating to play - now is the perfect time to give the game a try! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399930/Furry_Shades_of_Gay/][b]Furry Shades Of Gay[/b][/url] is also on sale, so go check it out! 

But here's more:

Yes, just like that, I'm telling you that you can now update the game and get all new mini-stories! 

It's vacation time and our heroes are oh so ready to warm up under the sun. Explore sea shores, hunt sea creatures and gain some summer body confidence with power couples having fun.

notes.title: HAPPY VALENTINE'S STORY!
notes.content:
Hi there, friends!

[h2]Happy St. Valentine’s Day![/h2] Keep your loved ones close. And we proudly provide you with [b]a bonus story![/b]

[h2]Valentine’s cabin for three[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/a893db357c7ff61b0d170a44cf1f59697f27c8d4.png[/img]

It’s the time we meet Robbie, Wolfgang and Misha again! As Wolfgang can’t decide what is his place in this relationship, Robbie decides it’s time he does, so he rents a cabin where they can spend the holidays all together and have some fun. He’s the core of this threesome, all energetic and playful, how can he not make his boyfriends get along? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/e671ce888f52ce10cbc113b4b056ffe065eb3133.png[/img]

Wolfgang is, on the other hand, just shy, he just needs to get involved in, and he’ll show the boys the best part of him. And it seems like Misha doesn’t mind Robbie’s ideas for this Valentine’s Day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/be7860362bbb3a107ecbbfc3225755b5e4abbd9f.png[/img]

These guys are going to become your OT3 in no time, I promise! Look at how cute they are together, aren’t they? 

And to make your holidays even better, there’s [b]a nice 20% discount[/b], so go ahead pick a copy for your loved ones! Also, reminding you that the [b]point shop got an update[/b] with the all new items for your profiles, come check it out.

And at last, I’m reminding you to check our [b][url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games/status/1492544025747877891?s=20&t=svxpno41TbmK-bjVtn6K9w]Twitter[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]Discord[/url][/b] every now and then, there are some news for those who'd love to support us more.

That’s all, friends, have a good Valentine’s!

Shane
